video.title: AsyncThrowingStream, Stream Continuation & Buffering Policy | Day 272
video.description:
Learn to explain how to build your own async stream that can fail and control how it stores values: AsyncThrowingStream, Stream Continuation & Buffering Policy, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
AsyncThrowingStream - An async sequence you build by yielding values by hand, which can also end with a thrown error.
Stream Continuation - The handle passed into a stream closure that you use to yield values and finish the stream.
Buffering Policy - A rule that decides how many yielded values a stream keeps when nobody is reading yet.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain AsyncThrowingStream, Stream Continuation & Buffering Policy in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
AsyncThrowingStream, Stream Continuation, Buffering Policy 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

AsyncThrowingStream - An async sequence you build by yielding values by hand, which can also end with a thrown error.
한국어: AsyncThrowingStream: 값을 직접 내보내며 만들고 에러로 끝날 수도 있는 비동기 시퀀스

Stream Continuation - The handle passed into a stream closure that you use to yield values and finish the stream.
한국어: Stream Continuation: 스트림 클로저에 전달되어 값을 내보내고 스트림을 끝내는 데 쓰는 핸들

Buffering Policy - A rule that decides how many yielded values a stream keeps when nobody is reading yet.
한국어: Buffering Policy: 아직 읽는 쪽이 없을 때 스트림이 값을 몇 개 보관할지 정하는 규칙

landscape.hook: Can you explain AsyncThrowingStream, Stream Continuation and Buffering Policy in English?

dialogue.title: A progress stream that can fail
dialogue.setting: Turning a callback API into a stream

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want a stream of download progress that can fail.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then use an AsyncThrowingStream. You build it by yielding values, and it can end with an error.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I send values into it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With the stream continuation. It is `c` here. Call `c.yield` for each value.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Call `c.finish` on the stream continuation, or pass `throwing` to finish with an error.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if I yield too fast and nobody reads?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That depends on the buffering policy. By default the stream keeps every value.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That sounds like a memory risk.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It can be. Set a small buffering policy, so old progress values are dropped.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good idea. Only the latest percent matters.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. An AsyncThrowingStream plus a small buffer fits progress well.
Use an AsyncThrowingStream when the progress can fail.
